outputs.explanation: The bar graph in panel A shows '**' significance brackets (with p<0.01 noted on the image) comparing nuclear/cytoplasmic HMGB1 signal across genotypes, but the caption text for panel A only describes the result ('signals were reduced... but restored') and does not name any statistical test used to generate the ** indicators.

The 9-week and 21-week subplots display '*' significance markers on specific day comparisons, but the caption for panel E ('Details of the rotarod performance...') does not state which statistical test was used to generate these asterisks; the test named elsewhere (under panel D) refers to a different, week-level comparison and is not explicitly linked to panel E's day-by-day comparisons.
